shows.overview: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

shows.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
shows.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

shows.title: Lucky
shows.overview: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

shows.title: Ann Droid
shows.overview: Ann, an advanced AI, grapples with human emotions while discovering dark secrets within the corporation that created her.
